lab.title: Build IQueryable and execute it with ToListAsync
lab.task: Query only completed rows for one employee and materialize the translated database query asynchronously.
lab.startingCondition: Session 31 created a real EF Core DbContext and SQLite database boundary. Session 32 separates building a provider-translated query from executing it.

steps.text: Step 1/12: In Infrastructure, create ClockEntryDataQueries.cs and declare public static class ClockEntryDataQueries.
Step 2/12: Inside the class, stub CompletedForEmployee returning IQueryable<ClockEntryEntity> and accepting TimeClockDbContext plus int employeeId.
Step 3/12: Inside CompletedForEmployee, return dbContext.ClockEntries.Where for the matching employee whose Clockout is not null.
Step 4/12: Remember: IQueryable stores an expression for the EF provider; it has not executed SQL yet.

Step 5/12: Inside the class but outside CompletedForEmployee, stub MaterializeAsync returning Task<List<ClockEntryEntity>> and accepting IQueryable<ClockEntryEntity> plus an optional CancellationToken.
Step 6/12: Inside MaterializeAsync, return query.ToListAsync(cancellationToken). Read the signature as: execute this entity query and eventually produce a List<ClockEntryEntity>.
Step 7/12: Build Infrastructure in Release before writing the test.
Step 8/12: In the test project, create ClockEntryDataQueriesTests.cs with an open in-memory SQLite connection and a TimeClockDbContext.
Step 9/12: Inside the test, save one matching completed row, one matching open row, and one completed row for another employee.
Step 10/12: Build the query by calling CompletedForEmployee. Deliberately store it as IQueryable<ClockEntryEntity>.
Step 11/12: Execute it by awaiting MaterializeAsync, then assert that exactly the matching completed row was returned.
Step 12/12: Run ClockEntryDataQueriesTests, then build the solution and run all tests with --no-build.

reveals.title: Solution
reveals.text: CompletedForEmployee builds the provider expression; MaterializeAsync executes it.

lab.expectedBehavior: Query only completed rows for one employee and materialize the translated database query asynchronously.

dotnet test PinkMachine19.TimeClock.sln --configuration Release --no-build
